executive_assessment.text: The summary projects 0.5–0.9 m sea-level rise by 2100; 10-year floods could damage up to 3.3% of assets (US$0.7–1.1bn).
Tourism and fisheries account for nearly half of Maldives GDP and employment; reef and fishery climate impacts are evident and projected to worsen by mid-century.
The summary says nearly all shallow coral cover could be lost if global temperatures exceed 2°C and recommends island-specific planning that incorporates sea-level rise, flooding, and ocean heating.
